title: Ford turns former Amazon warehouse into home for 125 historic cars
summary_full: Ford has converted a former Amazon fulfilment centre in Romulus, Michigan, into a 79,000-square-foot archive housing 125 historic vehicles. The collection includes the 1966 Le Mans winners, a rare Mustang prototype and a car from The Mary Tyler Moore Show. The facility will also help Ford designers and engineers study the company's automotive history.
